intent: Explain the dangerous settings action with one focal mark, preserving the native warning and confirmation. App.ts #native-warning states that saved settings on this device are deleted while the account and documents are kept. The actual click handler only calls confirm and updates #status; no storage deletion is implemented. The optional #consequences paragraph says preferences can be set again. Avoid redundant notes or an arrow to that replaceable paragraph.

targets.description: Existing button id=delete, type=button, labeled Delete saved settings, with aria-describedby=native-warning. Its click handler calls confirm('Delete saved settings?') before changing #status. mount checks that this target is unique.
